name: Cetuximab Monotherapy, Recurrent or Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
disease: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (non-nasopharyngeal)

biomarkers.note: No biomarker gate. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers v2.2026, SYST-A 4 of 7, single-agent cetuximab is listed among the Other Recommended Single Agents for recurrent, unresectable, or metastatic disease without a PD-L1 or molecular requirement.

lineOfTherapy: single-agent option in the recurrent/metastatic setting (Other Recommended); commonly used after progression on prior systemic therapy

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: recurrent, unresectable, or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma with no surgical or radiotherapy option
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers
Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, SYST-A 4 of 7 (Other Recommended, Single Agents: Cetuximab)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: non-nasopharyngeal primary; nasopharynx follows a separate systemic-therapy pathway (NASO-B)
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, SYST-A 1 of 7 (Principles of Systemic Therapy for Non-Nasopharyngeal Cancers header)

drugs.name: Cetuximab
drugs.infusionDuration: loading over 2 hr, subsequent doses over 1 hr

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: recurrent or metastatic head and neck in-indication anchor line 58216 (Table 23.9, Cetuximab for Recurrent or Metastatic Head and Neck Cancer, 250 mg per m2); standard administration schedule line 124823 to 124824 (400 mg/m2 loading dose week 1 over 2 hr, then weekly 250 mg/m2 over 1 hr; this schedule locator is in the colorectal cancer chapter, but the 400-then-250 weekly schedule is the standard cetuximab administration schedule)

drugs.notes: Cetuximab 400 mg/m2 IV loading over 2 hr in week 1, then 250 mg/m2 IV over 1 hr weekly. dosePerUnit records the recurring weekly 250 mg/m2 dose (cycleLengthDays 7, day 1 of each weekly cycle); the 400 mg/m2 week-1 loading dose is recorded in this note. The 250 mg/m2 recurrent or metastatic head and neck dose is anchored to DeVita 12th ed. line 58216 (Table 23.9, Cetuximab for Recurrent or Metastatic Head and Neck Cancer); the 400 mg/m2 loading then 250 mg/m2 weekly administration schedule is sourced to DeVita 12th ed. line 124823 to 124824 (the cetuximab administration schedule printed in the colorectal cancer chapter; it is the standard cetuximab schedule).

regimen.cycles: weekly until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

premedications.name: Cetuximab premedication
premedications.notes: antihistamine (and per institutional practice a corticosteroid) before the cetuximab loading dose per cetuximab labeling; infusion-reaction precautions.

supportiveCare: Monitor for cetuximab infusion reactions (especially the loading dose) and acneiform rash.

monitoring: imaging every 2 to 3 cycles in the recurrent/metastatic setting (Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, SYST-A 1 of 7 general principles)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher cetuximab infusion reaction or severe acneiform rash
doseModificationRules.text: Manage per cetuximab labeling; hold or reduce and obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for single-agent cetuximab in recurrent or metastatic non-nasopharyngeal head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Serves the squamous-cell head and neck sites (reference sites #32 to 39 and #41), not nasopharynx (separate NASO-B pathway) and not salivary gland (#40, separate protocol). Single-agent cetuximab is an Other Recommended option per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026 SYST-A 4 of 7. Cetuximab 400 mg/m2 IV loading then 250 mg/m2 IV weekly is sourced to DeVita 12th ed.: the 250 mg/m2 recurrent or metastatic head and neck dose is anchored to line 58216 (Table 23.9, Cetuximab for Recurrent or Metastatic Head and Neck Cancer), and the 400-then-250 weekly administration schedule is line 124823 to 124824 (printed in the colorectal cancer chapter; it is the standard cetuximab schedule). This single-agent, fully-dose-grounded protocol is provided in place of a paclitaxel plus cetuximab doublet, because the recurrent/metastatic paclitaxel dose is not stated in the cited sources (cetuximab is). Setting recurrent/metastatic, palliative intent. No numeric field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
